_comment: Canned per-asset extraction fixtures for MockExtractor, keyed by asset file NAME (never platform — extraction is platform-agnostic by design). Video/audio entries: has_speech comes from the (simulated) VAD verdict, NOT from whether a transcript exists. Image entries: texts read off the slide; the slide index is assigned by asset order, not stored here.

speech.text: Die Briefwahl wird massenhaft manipuliert, das ist längst bewiesen.
Teilt das Video, bevor es gelöscht wird.
Der digitale Euro kommt schon nächstes Jahr für alle.

trending_audio.mp4._note: Music-only sound, no speech. A naive Whisper pass would hallucinate fluent lyrics here — the VAD gate is what keeps speech empty.

trending_sound.mp3._note: Slideshow background music — VAD correctly finds no speech.
